analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($370.43) vs SMA5 ($364.62)/SMA20 ($389.97)/SMA50 ($385.29): Above SMA5, below SMA20/50 indicating weak short-term trend and confirmed downtrend in mid-term.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($398.16)/SMA200 ($368.63): Below SMA100, above SMA200 indicating mixed long-term trend.
· 52-week position (40.1%): Current price is 28.7% above 52-week low and 25.3% below 52-week high, in a historical mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (35.4→43.7): Exited oversold zone and entered neutral zone, confirming weakening upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-6.2212→-2.4326): Continued improvement in negative territory, weak signal for bearish reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $389.97): Sideways movement near the middle band confirms lack of direction, with band width narrowing to 26.73%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($370.33): Close to current price, based on Pivot (PP) $384.41.
· Swing Resistance ($374.23): Close to current price, potential for short-term bounce on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low not met, Lower High not met): Confirmed sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.36x): Below 5-day average, indicating reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): RSI neutral range consolidation, MACD improvement, and weak ADX trend meet conditions for a wait-and-see approach.
